title: A tidier monster plate
changes: The plate at the top of the screen is now small and calm: level, name, a thin health bar and icons for what a monster is weak to, resists and suffers from. Its frame shows how special it is, from plain bronze up to a demon-guarded boss plate.
Champions and elites add a row with their traits. Hold Alt to see everything in words: what each trait does, weaknesses, health numbers and more.
Songweavers: the hints about how a monster hears moved out of the chat. Hold Alt over a monster to read them.
